rationale: Within-source. The same video gives four different durations for the same career: two and a half years before making any money, profitable for about six years, predicting markets for about five years, and five and a half years to work out the seasonal pattern. Casual speech rounds numbers, so this is filed as MINOR rather than material - but it is recorded because every performance claim in this source is anchored to experience length, and no two of these figures reconcile without assumptions the source does not supply.
